Ofcom uses Ordnance Survey data for the checker property dataset.
The checker property dataset is updated three times a year.
Ofcom provides an API based on the same mobile coverage data that powers the checker.
The mobile coverage map is based on coverage predictions supplied by mobile network operators.
Coverage predictions are generated by computer programs that simulate mobile signal travel.
The prediction models account for obstructions such as hills, trees and buildings.
Coverage predictions are processed into a 50 metre by 50 metre grid across the UK land mass.
Ofcom verifies prediction data through real-world tests using dedicated measurement hardware.
Ofcom says real-world tests show computer-model predictions are generally reliable.
Ofcom states that coverage predictions cannot guarantee service at a location because of very local factors.
Ofcom aims to update coverage information every three months or alongside Connected Nations publications.
